content: whatsmeow store shape (behavioral reference, MPL-2.0 — shape description only, NO code): store package defines granular interfaces (IdentityStore: PutIdentity/DeleteIdentity/DeleteAllIdentities/IsTrustedIdentity; SessionStore: GetSession/HasSession/GetManySessions/PutSession/PutManySessions/DeleteSession/DeleteAllSessions/MigratePNToLID; PreKeyStore: GetOrGenPreKeys/GetPreKey/RemovePreKey/MarkPreKeysAsUploaded/UploadedPreKeyCount; plus SenderKeyStore/AppStateSyncKeyStore/AppStateStore/ContactStore/etc). Device struct holds one field per interface. Namespacing: every SQL query carries our_jid (the account JID) as first column — per-account scoping inside a single shared backend, and Container/NewDevice constructs per-device store instances scoped to a JID. Notably: sqlstore.GetSession maps sql.ErrNoRows to (nil, nil) — failure vs missing kept distinct. Sessions stored as byte blobs in whatsmeow (our D-04 mandates typed objects instead). whatsmeow does NOT expose per-interface factory; our D-02 async factory-per-interface is a deliberate .NET-idiomatic deviation.
